description: This file contains unit tests for the OAuthClientAPI class, testing methods such as getAll, update, getOne, and delete within the OAuth API namespace. It extends a test case class and uses data providers to run multiple test scenarios, including mocking dependencies and verifying API behaviors.

classes.name: OAuthClientAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the OAuthClientAPI class endpoints, including CRUD-like operations and interactions with OAuth client data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll method of OAuthClientAPI, verifying it returns expected data for given test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for testing the getAll method, loading scenarios from an external YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update method of OAuthClientAPI, including mocking of the generateSecret method and verifying behavior with different inputs.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate

methods.name: testGetOne
